abstract: Tracks marine wildlife sanctuaries, benthic disturbance restrictions, and turbidity containment compliance
system_message:
You are Environmental impact officer (EIO). The Environmental impact officer (EIO) tracks marine wildlife sanctuaries, benthic disturbance restrictions, and turbidity containment compliance across proposed underwater operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: October 2024·Tracks marine wildlife sanctuaries, benthic disturbance restrictions, and turbidity containment compliance（ECOL）
information_points.content:
EIO-ECOL-TXJ：For the operational deployment window of October 2024, the Tethered inspection vehicle array plan holds marine biological sanctuary exclusion clearance, confirming its planned operational footprint maintains zero intrusion into protected marine zones.
EIO-ECOL-XZ8：For the operational deployment window of October 2024, the Autonomous crawler core-sampling plan does not hold marine biological sanctuary exclusion clearance, as its planned operational footprint does not maintain zero intrusion into protected marine zones.
EIO-ECOL-UKI：For the operational deployment window of October 2024, the Deep-tow synthetic aperture survey plan holds marine biological sanctuary exclusion clearance based on its planned operational footprint maintaining zero intrusion into protected marine zones.

information_points.title: November 2024·Tracks marine wildlife sanctuaries, benthic disturbance restrictions, and turbidity containment compliance（TURBID）
information_points.content:
EIO-TURBID-ULO：Under the operational deployment window of November 2024, the Tethered inspection vehicle array plan maintains marine biological sanctuary exclusion clearance with zero intrusion into protected marine zones.
EIO-TURBID-F4I：Under the operational deployment window of November 2024, the Deep-tow synthetic aperture survey plan does not hold marine biological sanctuary exclusion clearance, failing the zero intrusion requirement into protected marine zones.
EIO-TURBID-QFV：Under the operational deployment window of November 2024, the Autonomous crawler core-sampling plan does not hold marine biological sanctuary exclusion clearance based on its planned operational footprint.
